offline.evidence: Attachments are stored as records, so they stay readable and writable offline.
offline.quote: Records can be read and written offline. Changes survive a restart with default settings.

devicePrimary.quote: Every device merges its own copy.

fullHistory.evidence: The cited statement covers records. Retention of replaced attachment contents is not documented.
fullHistory.quote: All prior record changes are retained.

anyServer.evidence: The user can select a compatible relay or self-host one.
anyServer.quote: Clients can use any compatible relay, including a self-hosted relay.

e2ee.evidence: Record contents are encrypted. Attachment file names are not covered by the cited guarantee.
e2ee.quote: Every synced record is end-to-end encrypted by default. No option disables encryption.

postQuantum.evidence: Key exchange and signatures use post-quantum schemes.
postQuantum.quote: Synced keys are exchanged using ML-KEM and changes are signed with ML-DSA.

keysNotAccounts.evidence: The library has no concept of users.
keysNotAccounts.quote: This library has no concept of user identities.

openSource.evidence: The client and required relay are MIT licensed.
openSource.quote: The client and relay are released under the MIT license.
